result.title: SRA: Spatial Reasoning Adapter via Evolving Social Interaction Graphs for Trajectory Prediction
result.summary: Predicting where multiple agents will move next is fundamental to autonomous driving, robotics, and any system that must share space with people safely. Modern stochastic predictors read off inter-agent interactions once from the observed past and keep that view fixed throughout the generative rollout, so the reciprocal geometric constraints that emerge as the joint future sharpens are not re-examined. We address this gap with SRA (Spatial Reasoning Adapter), a modular graph denoiser that is integrated into existing diffusion and flow-matching predictors without redesigning their generative cores. At every reverse step, SRA reads the host's current future estimate, builds a sparse Euclidean interaction graph on the predicted trajectories, and returns a residual correction to the host's decoding path. Our adapter consists of three core components: a sparse neighborhood retrieved with a learned query-key score and a geometric bias, a future-conditioned relational feature recomputed on the evolving prediction, and uncertainty-weighted message passing where confident agents act as anchors for uncertain ones. We instantiate SRA on three structurally different hosts (LED, MID, and MoFlow) across four multi-agent benchmarks: SDD, NBA, Soccer, and Football. SRA improves ADE for every host on every dataset, with average gains of 5.8% in ADE and 7.0% in FDE. A cumulative ablation shows that the three components act as one mechanism: only together do they improve every host on every sports dataset, indicating that spatial reasoning over the model's own evolving future, weighted by how far that future can be trusted, is broadly useful across denoising architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoo97/SRA.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SRA：一个可插入扩散/流匹配轨迹预测器的图去噪模块，在每个反向步依据宿主当前预测的未来轨迹重建稀疏欧氏交互图并输出残差修正，包含可学习 query-key 邻域检索、未来条件关系特征与不确定性加权消息传递，在三个宿主、四个基准上平均提升 ADE 5.8%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按当前估计逐步重算关系结构、并以置信度加权（确定度高的个体作锚点）的思路，可能为 LVR 中随 latent 状态动态筛选视觉证据、按可靠性聚合信息提供借鉴线索，但该文属多智能体轨迹预测，未涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态，需核查可迁移性。
